ABC News challenges FCC's early license review in court

ABC News has asked a federal judge to block the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) from conducting an early review of its broadcast licenses. ABC News alleges this review is retaliation by the Trump administration. The network described the FCC's actions as holding its head on a 'guillotine' in its filing.
